Game folder:
%1$s

%2$s

Copy the original PC release assets into this folder, preserving their directory structure. For app-specific storage, place them inside Android/data/com.c4rlox.simpsons/files, not directly inside Android/data.

The saved storage location will not change when permissions change. After copying the files, close and reopen the app.

Choose where to place the original PC game files:

WITHOUT storage permission: use the app-specific folder Android/data/com.c4rlox.simpsons/files. Place the game files directly inside files, preserving their directory structure. The app can read this folder without broad storage access, although some file managers cannot access it.

WITH storage permission: use the shared folder:
%1$s
It is at the root of shared storage, alongside Download and DCIM. It is created once permission is available.

Folder currently being checked:
%2$s

%3$s

To use app-specific storage, do not grant storage access. If access is already granted, revoke it in Android Settings before setup completes. To use shared storage, select Allow storage access below.

After copying the files, close and reopen the app. The location is saved once the three initial files are found. After the engine confirms access, the unused folder is removed only if empty and accessible.
Waiting for scripts.rcf, soundfx.rcf and art/frontend/scrooby/bootup.p3d in the folder being checked. All three files must be present and non-empty.
The storage choice could not be saved. Close and reopen the app to try again.

To read and write files in a non-private folder (outside Android/data), you need to grant this app storage access.\nThe first launch takes 2-3 seconds longer because the touch control icons need to be extracted and copied.
The game folder could not be created or is not writable. Check storage access and available space.

Storage settings could not be opened. During new-install setup, you can continue without granting access by copying the files into Android/data/com.c4rlox.simpsons/files and reopening the app. If shared storage was already saved, grant access in Android Settings and reopen the app.
